energyEstimate_kcal_per_day.basis: Mifflin-St Jeor resting energy: 10x90.7 + 6.25x183 - 5x45 + 5 = 1,831 kcal/day. DGA 2020-2025 Table A2-2 (prior edition; 2025-2030 has no table) for males 41-45: 2,200 / 2,600 / 2,800 kcal (sedentary / moderately active / active) for a 5'10" 154-lb reference man, so likely low for 6'0" 200 lb. Activity is unknown, so the plan targets ~2,300-2,500 kcal on desk days plus field-day add-ons.
